marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 全世界有你就好 | Quan shi jie you ni jiu hao

Yuan Zihao’s 2022 short story collection features six heartfelt tales filled with love and energy. From Nanjing to Beijing, and from Beijing to New York, the world becomes less empty and more beautiful when we have someone we cherish by our side—we are no longer alone. Whether it’s a birthday cake a sister gives her brother, a silent vigil a friend keeps with a marinated egg in hand, a mother braving all odds for her daughter, or a boy quietly in love from afar in a foreign land—these are all ordinary people in Zihao’s stories. They may be supporting characters in someone else's world, but in the eyes of those who love them, they are unparalleled heroes—brave and fearless protagonists in their own right
